edit.title: Edit Video
edit.replaceHint: Swaps the video file on this post. Everything else stays as it is: the post keeps its likes, payout, comments, upload date and its place in your profile. Leave this alone to keep the current video.
edit.uploadedTo: Uploaded to {{host}}. Press Save to swap it in.
edit.uploaded: Uploaded. Press Save to swap it in.
edit.encodeHint: After you save it still needs a few minutes to encode, and the old video keeps playing until it is ready. Your thumbnail is unchanged, so update it above if it no longer matches.
edit.thumbHint: Upload an image or paste a direct URL. Leave unchanged to keep the current thumbnail.
edit.listedHint: Shown in feeds, search and on your profile.
edit.unlistedHint: Hidden from feeds & search — still plays by direct link, stays on your profile (badged).
edit.remixOn: Others can create remixes/clips; you are credited as original author.
edit.remixOff: Others cannot remix or clip this video.
edit.trailerOn: Autoplays at the top of your profile’s Overview tab, replacing any trailer you set before.
edit.trailerOff: Make this the video that autoplays at the top of your profile’s Overview tab.
edit.nsfwHint: Hidden from feeds & search unless the viewer enabled NSFW; tagged nsfw on Hive.
edit.videoUploaded: New video uploaded. Save to apply it to this post.
edit.updatedEncoding: Video updated! The new file needs a few moments to finish encoding.
